Get a free demo
Data engineering, done properly

Every pipeline has a story.
We make sure yours has a happy ending.

10+ years building ETL, ELT and Reverse ETL pipelines, warehouses, dashboards, lakes and lakehouses - on-prem and in the cloud. Plus the small data apps that finally retire the spreadsheet nobody's supposed to touch.

Try the free demo Talk to us
What we do

Four ways we move your data forward

01 / Movement

ETL, ELT & Reverse ETL

Pipelines that move and transform your data reliably, in whichever direction the business actually needs it - into the warehouse, or back out to the tools your team lives in.

❮ ❯
02 / Storage

Warehouses, lakes & lakehouses

Database, data warehouse, data lake and lakehouse design - sized to what you actually need this year, not whatever's trending on a conference stage.

❮ ❯
03 / Interfaces

Data apps

Lightweight, database-backed apps that replace the spreadsheet your team is quietly running the business on - before it becomes a very expensive typo.

❮ ❯
04 / Where it runs

10+ years, local and cloud

On-premises or cloud, we've deployed and operated these systems on both for over a decade. We know the trade-offs, not just the marketing slide.

❮ ❯
Built in the open

Everything we deliver runs on our own open source

etlx is our ETL/ELT/Reverse ETL engine - the pipeline core behind every project we run. central-set-go is our database-backed application platform, for data apps, admin, APIs and dynamic websites. Together, they're where we're strongest - but our consulting goes well beyond the two of them: any data-integration challenge is fair game.
